description: This file defines a custom Android UI component, TouchHighlightImageButton, which extends ImageButton to add a visual highlight overlay when pressed or focused, using a theme-based drawable for the highlight.

classes.name: TouchHighlightImageButton
classes.description: A custom ImageButton that displays a blue highlight overlay when pressed or focused, utilizing a theme attribute for the highlight drawable.

methods.name: TouchHighlightImageButton
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the button with a given Context.

methods.name: TouchHighlightImageButton
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the button with a Context and AttributeSet.

methods.name: TouchHighlightImageButton
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the button with a Context, AttributeSet, and default style.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the button by resetting background and padding, and retrieving the highlight drawable from the theme attribute.

methods.name: drawableStateChanged
methods.description: Updates the highlight drawable's state to match the button's state and triggers a redraw.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Draws the button's image and overlays the highlight drawable.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Caches the view bounds for use during drawing.
